theorem.assumption: If the full IO DtN eigenvalues satisfy sigma_ell = (ell+1) + eps_ell with |eps_ell| <= A/(ell+1), i.e. the deviation from the flat-PG coexact ball DtN law is order -1 shellwise.
theorem.conclusion: Then for the determinant-selected shell covariance G_ell proportional to sigma_ell^(-beta), the shell-slope error obeys |d ln G / d ln(ell+1) + beta| <= 2 beta A / ((ell+1)^2 - A).
